title: Gitea
descript: Gitea is a lightweight self-hosted Git service. It provides repositories, issues, pull requests, wikis, releases, organizations and a web UI, and can run on modest hardware. This package runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container; the database, repositories and configuration stay in the application data folder.
release_note: 1. First release: Gitea 28.3.0 from Docker Hub, x86_64 + aarch64, non-root.
important: Open the web UI and complete the first-run installer to create the administrator account and the SQLite database. All state lives in DockerAppData/giteadocker/data. The SSH clone port (22) is not published; use HTTP clone, or add a port mapping if you need SSH. After the first run set GITEA__server__ROOT_URL (or ROOT_URL in data/gitea/conf/app.ini) to http://<NAS-IP>:8026/ so clone links are correct. Needs DockerEngine. Back up data before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP.

data_notes: `etc` holds `app.ini`; `data` holds `gitea.db` (SQLite), repositories, avatars, attachments and the SSH host keys. Copying both folders is a complete backup.
design_notes: **Non-root.** Runs as `1000:1000`; the image is designed for the `git` user.
**One volume, one web port.** `/data` keeps all state; only 3000 is published.
**Fixed image tag**, Docker Hub only, no privileged mode, no host network, no Docker socket.
limitations: SSH clone (port 22) is not published. Use HTTP clone; if you need SSH, add a host port mapping and adjust `SSH_PORT`/`SSH_LISTEN_PORT` in `app.ini`.
After the first run, set `ROOT_URL` to your external NAS URL; otherwise clone and webhook links may point to `localhost:3000`.
The first-run installer is open until you create the administrator account. Complete it immediately after installation.
Plain HTTP on the LAN; do not expose the published port to the internet without a TLS reverse proxy.

runtime_files.lifecycle: never overwritten; edit to set ROOT_URL/SSH

runtime_files.purpose: SQLite database, repositories, avatars and attachments
